mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wf_parallel_join WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND activation_id = #{activationId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM wf_parallel_join WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND instance_id = #{instanceId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wf_process_instance WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND instance_id = #{instanceId} AND deleted = 1 AND status IN ('PASSED', 'AUTO_PASSED', 'REJECTED', 'TERMINATED', 'INVALIDATED', 'CANCELLED'))
